label: Review-informed support and completeness-assumption sensitivity on previously examined finite models
eligible_omissions: Unique context-receipt IDs retained in a nominal world, reachable through the unchanged catalogue, and absent from initial_record_ids
aliases: Omit one physical record once; every query of that record returns its unchanged lookup_empty payload
preserved: Events, timestamps, decision-state exposure, source selection, mechanism, claim, initial evidence, non-context records, completeness assertion bytes, query catalogue and costs
nominal_contract: Exactly the original support and authoritative scoped completeness semantics, verified by the unchanged nominal Model/checker
expanded_contract: Loss closure at the declared budget; surviving positive receipts stay truthful, while authentic completeness assertions and nominal snapshot scopes do not guarantee post-omission receipt retention
deduplication: Identical current physical realizations merge; all nominal parents, exact omissions and snapshot/provenance facts remain evaluator-only
primary_denominators: All original full signatures for preservation; new signatures and the complete expanded signature population have separate counts and within-problem fractions; no probabilities or empirical frequencies
nominal_policy: Original-prior exact_optimal only, with unchanged choices and terminal rules; stop immediately after a charged observation empties nominal compatibility
policy_evidence_boundary: Only nominal model, original prior, catalogue, initial evidence and already paid answers enter planning; expanded support and omission provenance are evaluator-only
failure_handling: Retain failed or capped cells as unavailable with explicit denominators; never truncate support or replace problems
sampling_inference: None; exact finite support counts, not incident failure rates or independent samples
